prior_art: Asymmetric distance computation is established product-quantization practice; this gate tests deployment value and makes no novelty claim.
hypothesis: Leaving the transient learned256 query unquantized while keeping every stored gallery item in the unchanged 128-byte signed-int4 representation removes a material share of the measured OML SOP quantization loss.
arms: symmetric learned256 int4 query and gallery
float learned256 query against learned256 int4 gallery
float learned256 query and gallery ceiling

decision.on_pass: replicate the unchanged scorer on official OML In-Shop query/gallery
decision.on_failure: kill this exact asymmetric scorer without quantizer, scale, or head tuning
